name: Cell, Molecular, Developmental Biology, and Biophysics PhD

deadlines.label: 2027–2028 admission
deadlines.note: Program explicitly names academic year 2027–2028 and Fall 2026 applications.

applicationFee.note: Documented qualifying affiliation, department request or hardship evidence in application. No nationality restriction stated; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

english.note: KSAS prefers TOEFL100 or IELTS7, not universal hard minima; scores under two years. Degree exemption requires two full-time years in US/listed country, requested in application; English instruction elsewhere alone insufficient.

requirements.note: Non-US citizens/PR currently studying or working in the US need at least one US-source recommendation. All documents English or translated. At least four first-year laboratory rotations.

funding.note: Program funding includes stipend, tuition and health care through training grant, teaching budget and mentor research grants; no amount or explicit international coverage statement.
